thread:
maria: heads-up — running the new onboarding sampleapp through chaos tests and we reproduced duplicate resource creation when a 429 happens during token rotation. logs below.

jin: bummer. is this the auth-refresh race again? what backoff settings are we shipping in the starter kit?

maria: defaults: { maxRetries: 3, baseMs: 50, maxMs: 1500, jitter: 'full' }

teo: full jitter is fine generally but with baseMs 50 and full jitter you get near-zero retry intervals occasionally. combined w/ token refresh that retries immediately after refresh, two near-simultaneous requests land.

maria: example logs: `12:01:02.123 token refresh start`, `12:01:02.124 429 received`, `12:01:02.130 retry attempt=1 delay=12ms`, other node receives same create at `12:01:02.135` -> duplicate created.

lina: mitigation options: (A) generate Idempotency-Key on client for create ops by default, (B) add a minimum jitter floor (eg 75ms) for ops flagged as sideEffect:true, (C) add server-side short ttl dedupe for create endpoints. all three?

jin: recommend adding A + B in sampleapp and SDK defaults, and C as a quick safety net server-side. SDK parity note: need consistent behavior across node/python/go. propose SDK API: `client.request(op, { sideEffect: true, idempotency: 'auto' })` and a config global `safeReplayWindowMs`.

teo: name nit: `safeReplayWindowMs` ok. defaults: 150ms for sampleapp. expose as policy so teams can tighten/loosen per-route.

maria: also adding a dev-mode warning: if someone sets jitter floor < 20ms for ops with sideEffect:true, print console.warn and surface link to docs. low friction for new users.

ops-bot: ACTION assigned: maria -> create PR to update starter kit (add idempotency header + enforce jitter floor 75ms for side-effect ops) due 2026-03-16.

jin: PR checklist: update SDK readme + changelog, add integration test that simulates 429 during refresh and asserts single side-effect, add telemetry event `dup_detection` to compare before/after.

maria: I'll put together the PR and ping infra to add server-side short ttl dedupe on /create endpoints. thanks all :thumbsup:
